import re def extract_html_tags(html_string: str) -> list[str]: """ Extract all HTML tags from the given string. Parameters ---------- html_string : str The input HTML content to scan for tags. Returns ------- list[str] A list of all substrings that match the pattern `<...>`, representing complete HTML tags (including start, end, and self‑closing tags). """ if not isinstance(html_string, str): # Gracefully handle non‑string input without raising return [] # Regular expression to match HTML tags: # - `<` followed by any characters that are not `>` (lazy to stop at the first `>`) # - `>` to close the tag. # This captures tags like
, , , etc. tag_pattern = re.compile(r'<[^>]+?>', flags=re.IGNORECASE) # Find all non‑overlapping matches return tag_pattern.findall(html_string)
